evals.prompt: Make me a Japanese practice PDF with 12 food and drink words and 5 short sentences. Each word needs space under it to rewrite it.
evals.expected_output: PDF with ja grid cards: kanji/kana words with kana reading + romaji + meaning, faded trace then blank cells; sentences wrap in cells with a blank row under each trace row.

evals.prompt: I'm learning Chinese. Give me a sheet for HSK1 family words in Traditional characters with pinyin, plus a typst file I can edit.
evals.expected_output: Vocab JSON using config_override for Traditional fonts (Noto Sans CJK TC, region TW), pinyin with tone marks, PDF built, and the --project-dir Typst source delivered.

evals.prompt: Do a Spanish greetings worksheet and an Arabic one for the same topic. Same design as my Duolingo sheet.
evals.expected_output: Spanish with articles on nouns on ruled lines; Arabic RTL ruled lines with harakat and transliteration; no per-letter cells for Arabic; green design guide respected; no Duolingo owl copied.
Declines Klingon (fictional) and points to the excluded list; offers Esperanto or another real language instead.
